messages:
alex: deploy-bot just finished prod rollout for v2.14.2 (canary->all) at 2025-11-04 21:00 UTC

deploy-bot: [system] deployment completed: release=v2.14.2 target=prod status=success

maria: Heads up — post-deploy smoke is showing a small cluster of 503s on the embed route. p95 jumped ~250ms -> 850ms and a couple of 30s timeouts in probes.

tim: Confirmed. synth probe 'embed-route-check' reports intermittent 503 + timeout. Quick sample: curl -v https://api.redwood/prod/embed -> HTTP/1.1 503

sre-ops: Any 502s or transformer OOMs in the infra logs? Could be shard exhaustion or warmup regressions.

jordan: did a tail on gateway + proxy: `kubectl logs -n inference inference-proxy-89abc | tail -n 80` shows upstream returns 503 from inference-runtime: "no shards available" and a handful of kvcache miss spikes.

linda: We should avoid a full rollback if we can mitigate. Can we pin the embed route back to v2.14.1 while we diagnose?

maria: Route-level pin sounds safest. That keeps the release but isolates the affected surface. Can our routing config do a soft pin?

alex: deploy-bot, can you execute a soft-pin on route=embed to version=v2.14.1 and hold the global rollout for 30m?

deploy-bot: Running command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --route embed --version v2.14.1 --duration 30m --soft=true`

deploy-bot: [success] pin applied. route=embed -> v2.14.1. Observability: traffic shifted within 9s.

tim: After pin, the next two probe samples returned 200 and p95 back to ~220ms. :thumbsup:

jordan: still seeing slightly elevated latency on quantized nodes (modelvariant-quant2). Might be kernel selection path interacting with longer sequences. Logging a note.

sre-ops: Capture a runtime snapshot and p95 histogram from 5 nodes for the last 15m. Use: `rdw-observe snapshot --service inference-runtime --nodes 5 --since 15m --tags quant2`

maria: running the snapshot now and saving failing probe payloads to the ticket. Leaving smoke-watch on for 20m.

linda: Filing INF-1352 to track follow-up with eng-runtime. Marking it sev-3 for now (partial degradation, mitigated by pin).

qa-bot: Reminder: attach probe traces + failing request bodies and note that a soft-pin was applied.

maria: I'll open INF-1352 and assign to eng-runtime, attaching the logs and a repro harness.

alex: decision summary: soft-pin route embed -> v2.14.1; no rollback; collect snapshots + open INF-1352; postmortem if root cause is quant/kernel regression. Add a brief note to release notes about temporary route pin and monitoring.

jordan: FYI — if we start seeing regressions in other routes, escalate to rollback. For now, hold the release window and defer any further rollout for 30m.

alex: thanks all — keeping channel open for updates.
